aboutPage.description: VNX Robotics is developing intelligent industrial automation and robotics technologies focused on scalable systems, operational intelligence, and future autonomous infrastructure.
aboutPage.approachText: Our approach emphasizes scalable architecture, operational understanding, realistic deployment, and long-term technology capability building.

aboutPage.missionText: To develop practical industrial automation systems, intelligent robotics platforms, and connected operational technologies that enable modern industry to evolve toward scalable autonomous infrastructure.
aboutPage.leadershipText: VNX Robotics was founded with deep roots in robotics, reinforcement learning, intelligent systems, and industrial automation thinking.

privacyPolicyPage.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicyPage.introductionText: At VNX Robotics, we take your privacy seriously. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you visit our website or use our services.
privacyPolicyPage.infoCollectText: We may collect the following types of information:
privacyPolicyPage.infoCollectItem1: Personal identification information (name, email address, phone number)
privacyPolicyPage.infoCollectItem3: Technical data (IP address, browser type, device information)
privacyPolicyPage.infoCollectItem4: Usage data (pages visited, time spent, interactions)
privacyPolicyPage.howWeUseText: We use the collected information for:
privacyPolicyPage.howWeUseItem2: Communicating with you about updates, promotions, or support
privacyPolicyPage.howWeUseItem3: Improving our website and user experience
privacyPolicyPage.howWeUseItem5: Protecting against unauthorized or illegal activity
privacyPolicyPage.cookiesText: We use cookies and similar tracking technologies to enhance your experience. You can control cookie preferences through your browser settings. However, disabling cookies may affect certain features of our website.
privacyPolicyPage.dataSharingText: We do not sell your personal information. We may share your data with trusted third-party service providers who assist in operating our website, conducting business, or serving you, as long as they agree to keep your information confidential.
privacyPolicyPage.dataSecurityText: We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your information. However, no method of transmission over the internet is 100% secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.
privacyPolicyPage.privacyRightsText: Depending on your location, you may have the right to:
privacyPolicyPage.privacyRightsItem1: Access the personal information we hold about you
privacyPolicyPage.thirdPartyText: Our website may contain links to third-party sites. We are not responsible for the privacy practices or content of those sites. We encourage you to read their privacy policies.
privacyPolicyPage.childrenPrivacyText: Our services are not intended for individuals under 16 years of age. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 16.
privacyPolicyPage.changesText: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Changes will be posted on this page with an updated revision date. We encourage you to review this policy periodically.
privacyPolicyPage.contactText: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or how we handle your data, please contact us at:
